content: he proceeding concerned the division of a family home and rural land. During the trial, the parties renounced claims regarding the land and occupancy indemnities. The Court accepted these renunciations as equivalent to a dismissal on the merits. On the remaining issue of the house, the wife sought reimbursement for mortgage payments. The Court established that a spouse claiming credits for common debts paid after dissolution must provide specific documentary proof of payment; a single bank transfer without clear causality is insufficient to trigger a reimbursement debt.
